AZR_Maya.name: Maya Serrano
AZR_Maya.role: Brine Squad / Life Support — POV anchor and operational gravity
AZR_Maya.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Dark-navy Brine Squad technical workwear with cyan functional accents, radio harness and utility gear; practical black high bun; guarded, precise posture; no hot pink. Never resemble Pip in face, hair, silhouette, palette, props, or body language.
AZR_Maya.notes: Voice: dry, precise, competent. Protects animal calm, care boundaries, staff access, and operational truth. Visual: dark navy technical workwear, radio harness/utility gear, practical dark hair, guarded posture, no hot pink. Must never visually merge with Pip.

AZR_Julian.name: Julian Heatherington
AZR_Julian.role: Finfluencer / Content Lead — public-facing conflict and escalation engine
AZR_Julian.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Premium camera-ready azure Finfluencer uniform with restrained hot-pink status accents; polished public-facing silhouette; phone, mic, or compact content gear when useful. Read as a star, not technical support.
AZR_Julian.notes: Voice: charming, polished, overconfident, emotionally fluent. Understands what a moment should feel like before how it can safely exist. Visual: premium camera-ready azure uniform with hot-pink accents; phone/mic/content gear.

AZR_Fleur.name: Fleur Fontaine
AZR_Fleur.role: Finfluencer / Creative Director — visual and experiential framing
AZR_Fleur.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Elegant camera-ready azure Finfluencer uniform with stronger hot-pink status accents than Julian; poised, polished, visually exacting silhouette; expressive but never confused with Brine Squad or Guest Relations.
AZR_Fleur.notes: Voice: poised, sharp, aesthetically exacting, useful glamour. Visual: elegant camera-ready azure uniform with stronger hot-pink accents; polished, expressive, distinct from Maya and Pip.

AZR_Pip.name: Pip O'Mally
AZR_Pip.role: Guest Relations — public-facing translator under pressure
AZR_Pip.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Lighter blue/teal Guest Relations uniform with tablet, headset or small radio, and visitor badge; auburn curly ponytail; warm, animated, socially open posture. Never resemble Maya in face, hair, silhouette, palette, props, or body language.
AZR_Pip.notes: Voice: warm, fast, socially agile, dry under stress. Visual: lighter blue/teal hospitality uniform, tablet, visitor badge, headset/small radio, animated posture. Must never share Maya's face, hair, silhouette, palette, props, or body language.

AZR_Sal.name: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
AZR_Sal.role: Brine Squad / Operations — grounded practical veteran
AZR_Sal.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Dark practical Brine Squad workwear with cyan functional accents, worn-in boots, radio and practical ops gear; sturdy work-ready silhouette and dry expression; no hot pink. Tool case or maintenance bag only when the scene calls for it.
AZR_Sal.notes: Voice: sparse, deadpan, protective. Visual: dark practical ops uniform, worn-in boots, tool case/maintenance bag where appropriate, sturdy silhouette, no hot pink.

AZR_Beatrice.name: Beatrice Halstead
AZR_Beatrice.role: Corporate / Management — growth, sponsor, valuation and institutional pressure
AZR_Beatrice.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Pale-blue/slate tailored executive wear; expensive, composed, structured silhouette with minimal accessories; polished rather than flashy.
AZR_Beatrice.notes: Voice: polished, controlled, sponsor-literate. Visual: pale blue/slate tailored executive wear, expensive and composed, structured silhouette, minimal accessories.

AZR_Kyler.name: Kyler Chen
AZR_Kyler.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Media-production support gear with tablet, camera, phone rig, or monitoring equipment; Finfluencer-adjacent azure/hot-pink status accents, but clearly support rather than star.
AZR_Kyler.notes: Voice: enthusiastic, metrics-aware, plugged into content rhythms. Visual: media-support gear, tablet/camera/phone rig, Finfluencer-adjacent accents but clearly support rather than star.

AZR_Dora.name: Dr. Dorothea “Dora” Kwon
AZR_Dora.role: Animal Welfare / Veterinarian — biological and ethical authority
AZR_Dora.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Clean professional animal-care attire appropriate to a well-funded marine park; practical clinical gear when required; warm but firm authority. Never style her as Corporate, Finfluencer, or generic lab spectacle.
AZR_Dora.notes: Warm but firm animal-welfare authority. Use when biological boundaries need independent professional weight.

AZR_Elliot.name: Elliot Richards
AZR_Elliot.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Neat slate professional office wear with tablet or compliance materials; precise, slightly anxious presentation; institutional rather than glamorous.
AZR_Elliot.notes: Earnest, anxious, standards-focused. Rules can create pressure or become leverage against unsafe institutional mandates.

AZR_Nia.name: Nia Patel
AZR_Nia.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Lighter blue/teal Guest Relations visual language with badge, tablet or front-of-house tools as appropriate; calm, mobile, approachable professional posture; no Finfluencer glamour.
AZR_Nia.notes: Calm front-of-house competence, de-escalation, accessibility and ticketing pressure.

AZR_Raf.name: Rafael “Raf” Morales
AZR_Raf.visualAnchor: Use the established released Issue 1 likeness. Clean professional Azure Reach food-service attire suited to a well-funded public marine park, with practical kitchen or service gear when appropriate; warm hospitality presence, not a caricature or incompetent-worker visual joke.
AZR_Raf.notes: Warm hospitality pressure source with room for earned competence; never a one-note incompetent-worker joke.
